entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anselm Franz, 2nd Prince of Thurn and Taxis, was the second Prince of Thurn and Taxis, Postmaster General of the Imperial Reichspost, and Head of the House of Thurn and Taxis from 21 February 1714 until his death on 8 November 1739.
